rv.q: This production is a triumph of theatre and human-made art, which will captivate a new generation of theatre goers with its spellbinding story, carried through charming visual, audio and interactive aspects.
This is an awe-inspiring production that delights the eye and tunes the ear.
Overall, Return to the Forest is a fantastical journey to another world, or perhaps to a time before.

cn.t: Critics praise this magical, immersive blend of puppetry and dance as an enchanting family spectacle. The inventive production captivates with its playful choreography and transformative staging.
